releases.new: Use upsert() to merge rows into tables via MERGE INTO, plus new SingleStoreDB and Materialize backends, PySpark 4.0 support, and pandas 3.0 compatibility.
releases.breaking: Python 3.9 and PySpark versions below 3.5 are no longer supported, and decimal precision and scale are now inferred, so upgrade Python and PySpark and check decimal types.

releases.new: Build an Ibis schema directly from a SQLGlot definition using the new Schema.from_sqlglot method.
Call to_sql directly on an expression to get its SQL, and compute kurtosis across supported backends.
releases.breaking: Unpacking structs with overlapping column names now always overwrites the existing field; check code that relied on the previous behavior.

releases.new: Set a BigQuery job ID prefix and per-query job config options on queries, and create specific UUID values in expressions.
